Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.implicit

Class LegacyImplicitAuthenticationProvider

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.implicit.LegacyImplicitAuthenticationProvider
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.springframework.security.authentication.AuthenticationProvider
public class LegacyImplicitAuthenticationProvider extends Object implements org.springframework.security.authentication.AuthenticationProvider
Grants the legacy implicit request: after checking the client, its redirect URI, the user, the multi-factor policy, the state and the scopes, it issues an access token (never a refresh token) through the token generator, stores the authorization (so the token can be introspected and revoked) and returns it for the response handler.

  • Method Details

    • authenticate

      public org.springframework.security.core.Authentication authenticate(org.springframework.security.core.Authentication authentication) throws org.springframework.security.core.AuthenticationException
      Grants or refuses the request.
      Specified by:
      authenticate in interface org.springframework.security.authentication.AuthenticationProvider
      Parameters:
      authentication - the request, a LegacyImplicitAuthorizationRequestToken.
      Returns:
      the access token, or the error that must be sent in the fragment of the redirect URI.
      Throws:
      org.springframework.security.core.AuthenticationException - unsupported_response_type or unauthorized_client when the client is unknown or may not use the flow, invalid_request when the redirect URI is missing or not registered or the user is not signed in (none of them redirects), SecondFactorRequiredException when the user owes a second factor, or server_error when no token can be generated.
